name: The Fourth Rumour
summary: Vasile and Petre have traded the same three rumours since the mist came down. They might take a fourth, if somebody made one.

stages.journal: Vasile and Petre have traded the same three rumours outside the Blood of the Vine for years, in turns. Neither thinks a rumour can be made; they think it happens to you. They might be talked round.
objectives: Sell Vasile and Petre a fourth rumour
stages.hint: Talk to Vasile and Petre outside the Blood of the Vine in the village and offer them a fourth rumour.

stages.journal: The village has a fourth rumour now, and we made it. It will go round, and come back wrong; that is how a rumour is known to be working.
objectives: Ask around the village what people have heard
stages.hint: Ask Arik at the Blood of the Vine, or Goodwife Petra at the well in the village, what they have heard lately.

stages.journal: The rumour went round the village in a single morning and came back garbled. Vasile and Petre say that is how you know it is a good one, and claim it as theirs.
